summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish a National Headache Disorders Initiative to improve research, care, and public awareness of headache disorders, and creates an Advisory Council to guide these efforts, with the initiative sunsetting after five years.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a National Headache Disorders Initiative and an Advisory Council to improve research, care, and services for headache disorders. This directly involves federal intervention and coordination in healthcare, aiming to improve access and quality of care for a specific medical condition.
